title: How Leaving Your Phone in Another Room Changes a Godly Man's Morning
caption:
The first scroll happens before your feet hit the floor. Whoever gets your attention first shapes how you see everything after, so a godly man decides that before he's half-asleep and reaching for it.

Charge it in the kitchen, not the nightstand. Open the Word before you open the app. Sit in five minutes of actual silence and let whatever surfaces there get named instead of buried.

You won't out-willpower a notification at 6 AM. Decide the boundary the night before, and the phone doesn't get a vote in your morning.
